title: Daemon watch renews reservations while reporting no truth writes
description: The daemon architecture says it is an observer and status reports writesTruth: false, but runDaemonWatchOnce calls renewDaemonReservations, which writes through runtime.renewWorkReservation for active reservations near expiry.
acceptanceCriteria: Daemon watch either becomes explicitly opt-in for reservation renewal and reports writesTruth truthfully, or it stops mutating reservations.
Renewal requires ownership/heartbeat checks and emits clear operation/audit evidence.
Regression tests prove a default watch does not silently extend reservations while claiming observer-only behavior.
